purpose: Labelled part pairs for sampling a model's two overlap facts (same_stimulus, same_conclusion) in a later authorised run. Code applies the rule; this set evaluates only the reported facts. Test data only; never part of a prompt.
definitions: originality-policy-v1: stimulus = the specific material given (numbers or notation alone do not make it different); conclusion = the kind of final result required (differences caused only by numbers do not make it different).

cases.subject: mathematics

cases.part_b: Let f(x) = x e^{-x} for real x. Evaluate the limit of f(x) as x tends to infinity, justifying each step.
cases.note: One function; a classified stationary point versus a limit value.
